    Do You Want to Get Free

    Stuff From The ODIN?

    At The ODIN we are interested in not only selling people tools so that they can do genetic engineering and synthetic biology but growing genetic engineering literacy.

    You can help this happen by sharing links, pictures of yourself or your class doing experiments or biohacking and news articles that promote biohacking in a positive light.

    Recent Posts

    Team ODIN Delivers: Tasting Science at The Tech

    Team ODIN Delivers: Tasting Science at The Tech

    Micah James Zayner
    What does science taste like? Team ODIN brought eight amino acids to The Tech Museum in San Jose for an interactive tasting experience. From the sweetness of glycine to the surprising sulfur taste of cysteine, visitors got to explore biochemistry through their own taste buds.
    We Are All Biohackers

    We Are All Biohackers

    David Ishee
    What if anyone could help rewrite the code of life? Biohacker David Ishee shares how his family's experience with a rare genetic disease inspired him to explore genetic engineering, challenge the limits of traditional science, and imagine a future where citizen scientists help solve problems that others overlook.
    And the Nobel Prize goes to... A Biohacker

    And the Nobel Prize goes to... A Biohacker

    Jo Zayner, Ph.D.
    Could a citizen scientist or biohacker win a Nobel Prize? Explore why accessible science, education, perseverance, and collaboration are essential to advancing scientific discovery and helping independent researchers make a meaningful impact on the world.
    Biohacking

    Biohacking

    The Open Discovery Institute
    The computer hacker movement changed the world by making knowledge and tools accessible to everyone. What if biology could follow the same path? Josiah Zayner shares the original vision behind The ODIN: making biological research accessible, affordable, and open to anyone curious enough to experiment.
